plan.title: Knockout auction rejects a second bidding currency

steps.note: Start on the single-stage creation path.
Create the RFQ required to reach Knockout through conversion.
Give the source event a unique title.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Verify that the location was retained.
Invite two available QA vendors without inventing company names for Vendor A and Vendor B.
